mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may inhibit norethindrone metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition, potentially increasing oral contraceptive levels and adverse effects; additionally, MAOIs can cause fluid retention and hypertension, compounding hormonal contraceptive effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly and counsel on potential breakthrough bleeding or increased estrogen-related side effects; consider alternative antidepressant if possible; ensure adequate contraceptive backup awareness.
